meta.source: MIEMSS FY2025-26 Annual Report, "Jurisdictional EMS Operational Programs (JEMSOPs)" list
not_county: Maryland State Police Aviation Command (statewide air)
meta.caveat: A JEMSOP is the county or city 9-1-1 EMS program of record; the report does not say per program whether its own units or volunteer companies carry the patients.
